title.zh: 将达沃省哈戈诺伊市镇吉欣村北帕达达小学的名称变更为吉欣小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Northern Padada Elementary School in the Barrio of Guihing, Municipality of Hagonoy, Province of Davao, to Guihing Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Northern Padada Elementary School in the Barrio of Guihing, Municipality of Hagonoy, Province of Davao, to Guihing Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Northern Padada tại Barrio Guihing, Thị trấn Hagonoy, Tỉnh Davao thành Trường tiểu học Guihing
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Northern Padada ในบารริโอ Guihing, เทศบาล Hagonoy, จังหวัด Davao เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Guihing
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Northern Padada di Barrio Guihing, Kotamadya Hagonoy, Provinsi Davao menjadi Sekolah Dasar Guihing
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Northern Padada di Barrio Guihing, Perbandaran Hagonoy, Wilayah Davao menjadi Sekolah Rendah Guihing

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_5027_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Northern Padada Elementary School in the barrio of Guihing. Municipality of Hagonoy, Province of Davao, is hereby changed to Guihing Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
